verses.t: “Ayamiti kappaṭo kappaṭakuro, Acchāya atibharitāya; Amataghaṭikāyaṁ dhammakaṭamatto, Katapadaṁ jhānāni ocetuṁ.
Mā kho tvaṁ kappaṭa pacālesi, Mā tvaṁ upakaṇṇamhi tāḷessaṁ; Na hi tvaṁ kappaṭa mattamaññāsi, Saṅghamajjhamhi pacalāyamāno”ti. … Kappaṭakuro thero … vaggo catuttho.
Migasiro sivako ca, upavāṇo ca paṇḍito; Isidinno ca kaccāno, nitako ca mahāvasī; Poṭiriyaputto nisabho, usabho kappaṭakuroti.
